_comment: Payment engine data next to the clearing-account breaks (docs/Extensions_Overlay.md). The assignment of a clearing-account line carries the payment document (AUGBL) - confirmed for ACH and card, open for cheque (V139) - so the break group joins the worklist state of that payment (CD_PAY_WORK_STATE, ZI_CD_PayWorkState, one row per payment document): the source system of its requests, the open outcome and finding, late. Pending until V139 is closed. A single break line reaches no request: a clearing-account line is a G/L transfer of many FI-CA items or a bank posting, and the overlay has no to-one link from a journal line to the request log (decision D-H3).
